headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 10 AM EST THIS MORNING

periods.name: Rest of today
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots diminishing to 10 to 15 knots. Mostly cloudy. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: West winds 10 to 15 knots becoming southwest 15 to 20 knots. Partly cloudy. Waves 2 feet or less.

periods.name: Sunday
periods.text: Southwest winds 15 to 25 knots becoming west. Sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet.

periods.name: Sunday night
periods.text: West winds 15 to 25 knots. Partly cloudy. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Monday through Wednesday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 58 degrees, off Cleveland 61 degrees, and off Erie 59 degrees.

headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE SUNDAY NIGHT

periods.name: Rest of today
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 25 knots. A chance of waterspouts. Showers likely late this morning, then a chance of showers early this afternoon. A slight chance of showers late. Waves 5 to 8 feet subsiding to 3 to 6 feet. Waves occasionally around 10 feet.

periods.name: Tonight
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots becoming west. A slight chance of rain showers in the evening. Waves 3 to 6 feet subsiding to 3 to 5 feet. Waves occasionally around 7 feet.

periods.name: Sunday
periods.text: Southwest winds 15 to 25 knots becoming west to 30 knots. Sunny. Waves 3 to 6 feet building to 6 to 9 feet. Waves occasionally around 11 feet.

periods.name: Sunday night
periods.text: West winds to 30 knots becoming northwest. Partly cloudy. Waves 5 to 9 feet. Waves occasionally around 11 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Monday through Wednesday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 58 degrees, off Cleveland 61 degrees, and off Erie 59 degrees.
